steps.teacher_prompt: Hi there! My name is Ms. Linh. Can you say hello back to me?
steps.teacher_prompt_vi: Chào con! Cô tên là Linh. Con hãy chào cô đi.
steps.scene_image_prompt: A friendly kindergarten teacher waving warmly, soft warm pastel colors, cartoon kid-friendly illustration, plain pastel background, diverse appearance, no text
steps.hint_on_wrong: When you meet a teacher, you say 'Hi' or 'Hello'. Try again.
steps.praise_on_correct: Great job! That was a very nice greeting.

steps.teacher_prompt: Wonderful! Now tell me your name. You can say, 'My name is...'
steps.teacher_prompt_vi: Tuyệt vời! Bây giờ con hãy nói tên của con. Con có thể nói: 'Tên con là...'
steps.scene_image_prompt: Friendly teacher leaning down with a kind smile, listening attentively, soft warm pastel colors, cartoon kid-friendly illustration, plain pastel background, no text
steps.hint_on_wrong: Try saying 'My name is' and then your name.
steps.praise_on_correct: What a lovely name! It's nice to meet you.

steps.teacher_prompt: Class is over for today. How do we say goodbye to our teacher?
steps.teacher_prompt_vi: Hôm nay học xong rồi. Mình chào tạm biệt cô giáo thế nào?
steps.scene_image_prompt: Friendly teacher waving goodbye warmly at the end of class, soft warm pastel colors, cartoon kid-friendly illustration, plain pastel background, no text
steps.hint_on_wrong: When we leave, we say 'Goodbye' or 'Bye'. Try again.
